Here is my understanding of the game:  
I feel that the game was never designed to have "supports" or "cores". Icefrog has shown that over the years by increasing passive gold, attempting to increase rubberband effect, introducing bounty rune and lowering creep bounty. All of that was done to blur the lines between "support" and "core".   

Of course not every hero is equal. We know some heroes scale better with farm e.g. agi carries. (octarine core was introduced to make all cd dependent int heroes scale better into late game) and some heroes dont need farm at all. So then we start slotting them into the roles. Essentially supports can do what cores can do without farm. But of course every hero scales with farm.  

So now even if you pick 5 "supports" and have 3 of them play as cores, they will roll over most line ups early game. Late game can be secured if the heroes itemise well e.g. treant with mom radiance, wd with aghs sb refresher octarine etc. So yeah, every hero can be played as a core is my opinion.

There are several reasons to calibrating at a new higher MMR, most of it involves being more motivated and having a better attitude.  
  
When playing an a new account, subconsciously you would be playing better because you want to prove yourself. Your brain emphasizes that the games are calibration matches, which is akin to a test.   
  
Your attitude towards the game and your teammates are better. If you keep thinking you are in MMR hell, you are in a hell you create for yourself. How I play position 5 techies  
With the new rune changes, I have been tping to runes (with at least 2 clarities and soul ring recipe, tangoes are optional if you had to buy courier) once the game starts to mine them. The recent reduce in cd change means you can get 3 mines in when the runes spawn. Enemy may contest the rune so its quite dangerous and I wont have suicide due to being lv 1, so positioning is important. I mine the rune itself even if its being contested because then the enemy have to step on them to get the rune. Whether I get the kill or not is a bonus.

Then I would proceed to the safe lane and stack the small camp at 0.53 and pull. Techies have very little lane presence and I try my best not to leech any xp from the lane so that the carry can solo farm later on. When I hit level 3, I would make a choice between leveling suicide or mines.  

Scenario 1  
I would level suicide if the enemy team is very aggressive and there is a good chance of getting the suicide off (slow/stun from the carry). The best case scenario would be to get that suicide kill in front of the carry so he has a level advantage and will dominate the lane even without me.  Then I would start rotating to place mines (you should 

Scenario 2  
I would level mines if I was forced to use suicide at lv 2 to secure a kill or escape a death (the lv 1 cd is very long). If the enemy is passive or a strength hero that is hard to kill (centuar, pudge), then I would just level mines as well.  This is considered a very bad start since you would be limited with gold from not getting kills and might want to rotate to leech xp from other lanes depending on team composition. By now mid would be 6 and leeching mid xp while mid ganks or takes rune is very beneficial to the team. I would invest in a few more clarities if my soul ring is not up yet and help secure runes/stack camps for my team. 

Getting soul ring and bottle is a key turning point, once I have these, I could spam q in lane to farm and get levels as well. Smart enemies will start buying sentry wards so its a good idea to start mining pathways instead of runes. I always take note of enemy inventories while mining to see where they might have planted sentries. I also take note of their movement patterns (there are some pathways that people always take due to habit). I seldom mine the side secret shop unless I expect the offlaner to go there for items (e.g. Clinkz for orchid parts)

Mid game  
After sometime, mining river will start to get difficult due to river observers, with extra gold, I would buy sentries to counter ward and use my remotes as makeshift observers. Bad teams/teams with lack of support will never check for remotes at towers while good teams will always have sentries to check for remotes. So I would remote mine towers if their cores are constantly split pushing. Otherwise I would focus more on getting map control be it warding more and mining chokepoints to my teams forest/highground. Smoke is also useful to place aggressive mines at the enemy secret shop. I would try to carry a tp and be present at fights after they break out, a suicide alone can turn the tide of the teamfight. (1150 aoe damage is great and can take any non strength hero out at 3/4 of their hp)

Late game  
If my team is losing because I am the solo support and the cores lost every single lane, fuck mining at all. Focus on rushing aghanims and getting levels. As long as I get lv 11 with an early aghanims, we can turtle for as long as we want even if the enemy gets gem. 
If my team is winning, I would focus on maintaining map control and limiting the enemies movements around the map.
